scope: bounded reproducibility and determinism qualification only; no formal or long training

authority.scientific_semantics: original author/upstream implementation at the frozen commit
authority.heat3d_formal_backend: frozen JAX/XLA implementation; deterministic flag is a diagnostic dimension

allowed_numerical_drift.checkpoint_load: must restore the saved state exactly within the same process/backend contract
allowed_numerical_drift.resume: normal GPU numerical drift is allowed after a valid restore; systematic divergence is not

fail_conditions: NaN or Inf in forward, loss, gradient, update, optimizer state, or prediction
systematic trajectory divergence not attributable to bounded floating-point reduction order
same-seed run-to-run noise that is not negligible relative to seed-to-seed variability
scientific contract, role, provenance, or backend mismatch

qualification_rules.gino_same_seed_noise_target: same-seed variability / inter-seed variability < 0.10 on the predeclared bounded metrics
qualification_rules.gino_geometry: 896 train/valid_iid coordinate audit must retain non_boundary_disagreement == 0
qualification_rules.heat3d_deterministic_flag: true/false are compared with explicit block_until_ready; false may become an amendment candidate only when finite, stable, non-systematic, and reproducibly faster
qualification_rules.accuracy: never used to select a backend, radius, tolerance, budget, or amendment

supersession_policy: This policy changes the reproducibility decision rule only; it does not delete, rewrite, or retroactively upgrade any historical FAIL-CLOSED receipt. Formal configuration remains unchanged until a separately approved amendment.
